entries.german_term: Punct, Gerade Lini, Zirckellini, Schlangenlini, Barlini
entries.latin_1532_term: Punctum, Linea recta, Circulus, Linea serpentina, Parallela
entries.english_title: Foundational Definitions: Point, Straight Line, Circle, Serpentine & Parallels
entries.summary: Coinage of foundational German geometric terminology from Euclid Book I Definitions 1–23, augmenting straight and circular lines with the inflected serpentine S-curve (Schlangenlini).

entries.english_title: 12-Sector Archimedean Spirals, Projective Volutes & Spatial Helices
entries.summary: Pointwise polar constructions of Archimedean spirals (r = a*theta), projectively foreshortened logarithmic-like spirals, Ionic volutes, and two-view cylindrical helices.

entries.english_title: Conchoid of Nicomedes & Slotted Mechanical Trammel
entries.summary: 16-ray pointwise construction and physical pin-and-slot linkage generating Nicomedes's conchoid r = b + a*sec(theta).

entries.german_term: Elipsis / Eierlini, Parabola / Brennspiegellini, Hiperbole / Gabellini
entries.english_title: Two-View Orthographic Descriptive Geometry of Conic Sections & Burning Mirror
entries.summary: First printed Mongean elevation-plus-plan construction of the three Apollonian conics; proves w_k^2 = (2/9)*k*(12-k) is strictly bilaterally symmetric despite Dürer's egg-line (Eierlini) visual hypothesis.

entries.english_title: Regular, Star & Semiregular Planar Tilings and Pentagonal Parquetries
entries.summary: Systematic exploration of how regular and star polygons tile the Euclidean plane or leave structured interstices—directly inspiring Kepler's Harmonices Mundi Book II (1619).

entries.german_term: Fünffeck demonstrative vs. Fünffeck mit unverrucktem Zirckel
entries.latin_1532_term: Pentagonum Euclidis vs. Pentagonum circino immoto
entries.english_title: Euclid/Ptolemy Q(phi) Pentagon vs. Dürer's Single-Aperture ('Rusty Compass') Pentagon
entries.summary: Contrasts Ptolemy's exact golden-section pentagon (108°) with Abū al-Wafāʾ / Geometria Deutsch's single-aperture equilateral pentagon (all sides Q=1, base angle 108.3661°, error +21.97').

entries.english_title: Workshop Constructions of the 7-, 9-, 11-, and 13-gons & Wantzel-Gauss Cubic Audit
entries.summary: Audits Dürer's half-equilateral heptagon Q = 3/4 against Eisenstein-irreducible P_7(q) = q^3 - 7q^2 + 14q - 7 (residual -1/64, -0.2008% chord error), plus s_11 = 9/16 R (-0.1713%) and s_13 = 1/2 R.

entries.english_title: Euclidean Area Transformations (II.14, VI.13) & 8/10-Diagonal Circle Quadrature
entries.summary: Exact mean-proportional squaring of rectangles and polygon area addition alongside the explicit workshop quadrature d = (4/5)*sqrt(2)*a implying pi_Durer = 25/8 = 3.125 (-0.528% error).

entries.english_title: Architectural Columns, Nuremberg Gnomonics (49° Pole) & Optical Tower Scaling
entries.summary: Vitruvian entasis and twisted columns, equatorial/horizontal/mural/polyhedral sundials calibrated to Nuremberg's 49° latitude, and equal-visual-angle projection for high inscriptions.

entries.english_title: Compass-and-Straightedge Roman Capitals (10x10 Square) & Modular Gothic Textura
entries.summary: Constructs A–Z inside the 10x10 (and 9x9) square with 1 : 1/3 stroke contrast, circular serif fillets, and shifted-diagonal bowls, paired with unit-square combinatorial Textura minuscules.

entries.english_title: First Printed Planar Fold-Out Nets for the 5 Platonic & 7 Archimedean Solids
entries.summary: Transforms Pacioli and Leonardo's 1509 spatial polyhedra into exact 2D paper/copper fold-out nets with unit edge quadrance across all interior fold hinges and open boundary seams.

entries.english_title: Delian Doubling of the Cube via Sporus, Plato's Mechanical Square & Hero's Neusis
entries.summary: Three classical constructions of two mean proportionals g : c = c : d = d : e (c^3 = g^2*e) applied to doubling/tripling the Delian altar and scaling cannonball weights.

entries.english_title: Two-View Cube Sciagraphy & Homogeneous Central Projection via Glass Frame Apparatus
entries.summary: Couples plan-and-elevation cube shadow projection with exact ray-plane central projection onto the glass picture frame, preserving collinearity, vanishing points, and harmonic cross-ratios.
